findings.finding: Long default logarithmic tick labels near one clip the top-left y-axis label. Compact labels with adequate precision or wider margins are required; values and logarithmic scale must remain unchanged.
Use integer major ticks for count panels; saved counts and bar labels are correct.
Explain that collapsed normal Monte Carlo intervals show zero observed variation and do not prove population equality.
